articles.headline: Ethereum reclaims $2,500 as exchange supply dro...
articles.description: Ethereum has regained the $2,500 price level amid a significant 28% drop in ETH held on exchanges since May 2025, reducing the liquid supply available for trading. Increased staking, now at over 35%, further removes ETH from circulation, tightening supply. Additionally, U.S. Spot ETH ETFs have grown to $16.7 billion in assets, absorbing more ETH and limiting availability on open markets. This combination makes Ethereum's price more sensitive to spot demand, with future price stability depending on continued buyer interest versus potential selling pressure.

articles.headline: Bitcoin could hit $100K and Ethereum $4K by yea...
articles.description: Bitcoin reaching $100,000 and Ethereum hitting $4,000 by the end of 2026 are possible but conditional scenarios. Bitcoin needs sustained institutional demand, ETF inflows, and favorable Federal Reserve policies, while Ethereum requires increased network activity, DeFi growth, and a rising ETH/BTC ratio. Both targets face risks from macroeconomic stress and technical resistance. Investors should monitor market liquidity, trading volume, and asset-specific demand signals to assess the likelihood of these price milestones.
